sourceContext.originPage: WKND adventure detail page (Bali Surf Camp)

suitableFor: adventure / product / article detail hero image slideshows
full-bleed rotating galleries of images with NO overlaid text
single or multi-image banners at the top of a detail page
notSuitableFor: hero carousels needing overlaid heading/description/CTA per slide (use carousel-hero)

notes: New variant derived from the AEM Block Collection 'carousel' block. A DISTINCT name from the existing 'carousel-hero' is used because carousel-hero renders a content card (image + heading + description + CTA) overlaid per slide for the homepage hero and positions its indicators/arrows outside/below the block, whereas this adventure carousel shows a single image per slide with no overlay. Content model: first row = block name; each subsequent row = one cell containing a single image. Adapted for this stripped @adobe/aem-boilerplate: the vanilla 'fetchPlaceholders' (aem.js) and 'moveInstrumentation' (scripts.js) imports and calls were REMOVED because neither is exported in this doc project; aria labels are inlined and no aem.js import is needed. Handles a single slide gracefully (no indicators/arrows).
